title: My Brother-in-Law Stole My $90K Pension and the Compost Patent. So I Own His Company Now
description: Lillian poured her entire factory pension into a compost patent on a 50/50 handshake with her brother-in-law, only for him to forge her signature and land a $600k city contract alone. When she proved the forgery, she won half the royalties and the entire company, then rebranded it 'Composted Lies Inc.' and now donates to a forgery-detection nonprofit, listing him as 'Inspirational Fraudster of the Year' on every check. #RevengeStory #ForgeryExposed #CompostedLies
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY SIGNATURE, NOW I SIGN HIS CHECKS
pinned_comment: What would you do if your brother-in-law stole your entire $90,000 factory pension and forged your name off a compost patent you built together? Tell me your story if you've ever faced a betrayal like this in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: HE FORGED MY NAME OFF THE PATENT
AFTER MY FATHER'S DEATH, A HIDDEN CEDAR BOX NOTE WARNED ME
I PROVED THE FORGERY IN COURT
NOW I DONATE AS 'FRAUDSTER OF THE YEAR'
